subject: SIG intake & evidence sprint — FallowWorks scheduling
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda@fallowworks.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fallowworks.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: SIG intake + evidence request for FallowWorks

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting a SIG/CAIQ intake for FallowWorks as part of our procurement window and would like to schedule a focused call to walk through the questionnaire and confirm artifact owners. High-level asks:

- 60 minute working session to go through top 40 prioritized questions (we included our initial priority list).
- Attachment handoff for logs and encryption diagrams.
- Clarify retention windows and where log exports live.

Ideal dates for us: June 2 or June 3 (morning PT). Can your team do either? Also attaching an initial question workbook (fallowworks-sig-questions.xlsx) so you can pre-assign owners.

Thanks — Amanda
Amanda Lee
Security Program Manager, FallowWorks
amanda@fallowworks.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda@fallowworks.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fallowworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake + evidence request for FallowWorks

Hi Amanda — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the workbook — we can take the June 2 slot at 10:00 AM PT. I booked a 60-minute working session and put Marissa on the calendar to cover SOC 2 evidence and artifact transfer, and Ben will join for logging/export details.

Quick pre-call notes / asks for an efficient session:
- Please flag the 10–15 questions you want us to prioritize during the live review (sheet tab: PRIORITY).
- For log samples, confirm the date range (we typically provide a 48–72 hour sample) and the target anonymization requirement.
- If there are any third-party attestation items (e.g., SAML integrations) call them out in column F of the workbook.

Attached: fallowworks-sig-questions.xlsx (your sheet) + redwood-logs-sample-instructions.pdf (how we prepare sanitized exports).

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/j/874523019
Calendar invite sent.

See you Tuesday — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 14:30 -0700
Subject: FallowWorks SIG prep — owners & quick runbook

Marissa / Ben — looping you in on the intake. Amanda confirmed June 2 at 10:00 AM PT. Please see the prep runbook below and assign owners in the shared sheet before EOD Monday.

Runbook (high level):
- Marissa: SOC 2 / CAIQ control mapping, evidence artifacts (policies, role lists, SOC 2 scope). Target: upload to shared Drive by 2027-06-01 12:00 PT.
- Ben: Logging samples & export instructions, sample anonymization, retention policy doc (we have redwood-logs-sample-instructions.pdf). Target: prepare 48-hour sample and a one-page runbook for how exports were generated.
- Stephanie: intake lead, agenda, and Q&A triage during the call. I will coordinate any follow-ups and DocuSign/attestation links.

Agenda draft (will finalize and send to Amanda):
1) 10m — Introductions + scope confirmation
2) 30m — Live review of priority questions (Amanda areas flagged)
3) 10m — Artifact handoff logistics + test export cadence
4) 10m — Next steps & owners + deadline alignment

Attachments referenced: fallowworks-sig-questions.xlsx, redwood-logs-sample-instructions.pdf

Please update the owners column in the sheet and add any blockers.

— Steph
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fallowworks.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda@fallowworks.com>
Date: 2027-05-30 16:05 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake + evidence request for FallowWorks

Thanks — confirming June 2 at 10:00 AM PT works for us. Couple quick clarifications ahead of the call:
- For logs, can you confirm what fields will be present in the sample (timestamps, user_id hashed, request paths, response codes)? We need to validate schema compatibility with our pipeline.
- Retention detail: we are primarily concerned about 90 day vs 365 day retention for API transaction logs. Can you bring the retention table?

We'll be prepared with the prioritized question list on our side. Looking forward to the run-through.

Tom Reynolds
Director, IT Risk, FallowWorks
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31 08:15 -0700
Subject: FallowWorks working session — agenda, artifacts, and prep links

Amanda / Tom — thanks for confirming. Final agenda and prep packet below. Please review the attached workbook and add your top 12 priority questions to the PRIORITY tab.

Final agenda (60m):
- 10m: Intros + confirm scope (Steph)
- 30m: Live Q&A on prioritized SIG/CAIQ items (Marissa + Amanda lead)
- 10m: Logs sample schema & retention table (Ben)
- 10m: Evidence handoff plan + deadlines (Steph)

Prep packet & links:
- fallowworks-sig-questions.xlsx (priority tab) — attachment
- redwood-logs-sample-instructions.pdf — attachment (we will provide a 48-hour sanitized export; fields: timestamp, request_id (uuid), user_id (hashed), path, status_code, latency_ms)
- Meeting: https://meet.redwood.com/j/874523019 — Tue Jun 2, 2027 10:00 AM PT
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/FW-2027-034

Post-call deliverables (owners & deadlines):
- Evidence bundle (policies, diagrams, role lists) — Marissa — due 2027-06-07
- Log sample & export runbook — Ben — due 2027-06-04
- Q&A follow-ups and attestation link — Stephanie — due 2027-06-09

If anything changes on your side, flag now. Otherwise, see you Tuesday.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
